harness: Original cable included with Waveshare 19192; shortened at its jumper end
board_connection: Direct soldered through J6; optional 2.54mm male header NOT populated
wire: Original included wires; no replacement wire or crimp contacts purchased
manufacturer_bend_radius: Unpublished; 3mm static dressing bend is the user-authorized engineering approximation, not a supplier rating
trim_instruction: Trial-route supplied lead; target about 37mm insulated span from PH housing back, plus 2.55mm stripped board end. Trim each wire to its actual dressed path; solder tails <=0.8mm below PCB. Keep the original PH display plug.
screen_pose: 180deg about Y from official STEP, plus Z17.75mm; tab points -X
scope: Cable type and 20cm package length verified on Waveshare product page/photo. Plug, wire OD and static bends use user-authorized best approximations. The nominal model is 1.2mm OD; the larger 1.5mm wire envelope is checked separately. These are engineering assumptions, not measured supplier data.
